## Pre-merge review
<!-- Required (CLAUDE.md, .claude/skills/pre-pr-review). A PR with this section empty is not ready to merge. -->
- **Tier:**
- **Checks** (last lines of each, from REVIEW.md's table; any failure "also on main" shown on the merge-base commit):
- **Reviewers** (4 agents, other model; one line each, `none` if nothing): Data / Money / Reuse and cut / Tests and edge cases
- **Verifier:** N confirmed, N rejected, N pre-existing
- **Security review** (High tier):
- **Findings:** count line first ("2 to fix, 1 pre-existing, 3 skipped"), then each with what was fixed
- **Cal read the diff** (High tier): pending / yes
